risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~22% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.053), which favours a robust combination.

attempts.rationale: Start with a simple baseline mean over the full pool to gauge performance.
The ranking is unstable and several models are correlated; a weighted inverse-error combination may exploit the best performers while still mixing correlated groups.
Test a different weighting scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if a probability‑like weighting improves over inverse_error, given unstable ranking and high correlation groups.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of highly correlated outliers.
The series has high trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust simple aggregation like median may reduce influence of outliers and correlated errors.

Test a weighted combination using the best_per_horizon handle (w4) to see if per-horizon weighting improves over trimmed mean; the series has unstable ranking and several correlated groups, so a horizon‑specific mix may help.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a DBA that adapts to recent performance may capture shifts.
The ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a forward‐selection weight that picks a small complementary subset may outperform a full‐pool weighted average.
Test a weighted combination on the reduced, more diverse pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if a lighter pool improves performance in this medium predictability, highly seasonal series.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; try a per‑horizon weighted combo on the strong pool to capture horizon shifts.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9518. Series context: trend strength 0.9999 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.053); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.286.
